blocks.title: Mobile App Development Services
blocks.description: Plan, build and evolve mobile applications around your users, your operations and your business goals.

blocks.title: Mobile experiences built around real business needs
blocks.body:
A useful mobile product connects a clear user need with dependable engineering. We bring product discovery, interface design and application development into one delivery approach.

From a first release to the evolution of an existing platform, we help define what to build, how it connects to your systems and how it can be maintained after launch.

blocks.title: The value of a considered mobile experience

items.title: Reach people where they work
items.description: Put essential tasks within reach, whether users are at a desk, on site or on the move.

items.title: Connect your operations
items.description: Bring mobile workflows together with the data, services and systems your organization already uses.

items.title: Make everyday tasks simpler
items.description: Design focused journeys that help people find information, complete actions and understand the next step.

items.title: Build a foundation for change
items.description: Use an architecture and release process that can accommodate feedback, new features and evolving needs.

items.title: Mobile strategy and discovery
items.description: Clarify the audience, product goals and constraints. Turn the opportunity into a prioritized scope, an approach and a delivery plan.

items.title: Native iOS and Android development
items.description: Build platform-specific experiences with attention to device capabilities, interface conventions and lifecycle behavior.

items.title: Cross-platform development
items.description: Explore a shared codebase where it suits your product, while addressing the differences that matter on each platform.

items.title: Application modernization and support
items.description: Review an existing application, improve its maintainability and plan updates around technical priorities and user needs.

items.title: Connected field teams

blocks.title: Mobile engineering across the product lifecycle

items.title: Full-cycle development
items.description: Connect discovery, design, engineering and release in a coordinated delivery plan.

items.title: API and system integration
items.description: Connect the application to business services through well-defined interfaces.

items.title: Application security
items.description: Consider access controls, secure data handling and threat scenarios throughout delivery.

items.title: UI/UX design
items.description: Shape clear navigation, useful content and inclusive interactions for smaller screens.

items.title: Quality assurance
items.description: Test important journeys, error states, interruptions and supported devices.

items.title: Maintenance and evolution
items.description: Prioritize improvements, monitor issues and plan updates as the product changes.

items.description: Consider focused features such as assisted search or recommendations with appropriate human oversight and data handling.

blocks.title: A four-phase mobile app development journey

items.title: Discover and define
items.description: Understand users, map the essential journeys and agree on scope, constraints and success criteria.

items.title: Design and validate
items.description: Explore the experience through interface designs and prototypes; review assumptions before implementation.

items.title: Build and test
items.description: Develop in manageable increments, integrate services and validate functionality, usability and reliability.

items.title: Launch and evolve
items.description: Prepare the release, establish support responsibilities and use feedback to guide the next improvements.

blocks.title: Choose a collaboration model for your project

items.title: A dedicated delivery team
items.description: Bring product, design and engineering roles together around a shared backlog and an agreed delivery rhythm.

items.title: Extend your team
items.description: Add the capabilities your existing team needs while keeping your processes and product direction in place.

items.title: A focused project
items.description: Define a bounded outcome, scope and milestones for a new application, an integration or a modernization effort.

items.title: Consulting
items.description: Assess your architecture, clarify a technical decision or shape a roadmap with a focused advisory engagement.

blocks.title: A practical approach to mobile delivery

items.title: Business context first
items.description: Align product choices with the people using the application and the operations it supports.

items.title: Visible progress
items.description: Work from a prioritized backlog with regular reviews of completed work and upcoming decisions.

items.title: Quality throughout delivery
items.description: Consider usability, security and maintainability alongside feature development.

items.title: A clear handover
items.description: Document essential decisions, release steps and support responsibilities so the application can continue to evolve.

items.question: How do we choose between native and cross-platform development?
items.answer: The choice depends on your user experience, device integrations, team capabilities and maintenance expectations. Discovery helps weigh these tradeoffs before selecting an approach.

items.question: Can you work with an existing mobile application?
items.answer: An initial review can identify architecture, quality and delivery constraints. From there, we can define a plan for targeted improvements, modernization or continued feature development.

items.question: How long does a mobile application take to develop?
items.answer: Timing depends on scope, integrations, design complexity and release requirements. A discovery phase helps define milestones and a realistic delivery plan.

items.question: How are security and privacy addressed?
items.answer: The requirements should cover authentication, authorization, sensitive data, third-party services and relevant organizational policies. These inform design decisions, implementation and testing.

items.question: What happens after launch?
items.answer: Support responsibilities, monitoring, issue handling and planned improvements should be agreed before release. The ongoing approach can then evolve with the application and its users.

items.question: Can the app connect to our existing systems?
items.answer: Integration begins with an assessment of the available APIs, data models and access requirements. This establishes a practical approach for connecting mobile workflows to existing systems.

blocks.title: Gerçek iş ihtiyaçları için mobil deneyimler
blocks.body:
Faydalı bir mobil ürün, açık bir kullanıcı ihtiyacını güvenilir mühendislikle birleştirir. Ürün keşfini, arayüz tasarımını ve uygulama geliştirmeyi ortak bir teslimat yaklaşımında buluşturuyoruz.

İlk sürümden mevcut bir platformun gelişimine kadar neyin geliştirileceğini, sistemlerinize nasıl bağlanacağını ve yayından sonra nasıl sürdürüleceğini birlikte tanımlıyoruz.

items.question: Yerel ve çapraz platform geliştirme arasında nasıl seçim yapılır?
items.answer: Seçim; kullanıcı deneyimine, cihaz entegrasyonlarına, ekip yetkinliklerine ve bakım beklentilerine bağlıdır. Keşif aşaması bu seçenekleri değerlendirmeye yardımcı olur.

items.question: Mevcut bir mobil uygulamayla çalışabilir misiniz?
items.answer: İlk inceleme mimari, kalite ve teslimat kısıtlarını belirleyebilir. Ardından hedefli iyileştirme, modernizasyon veya özellik geliştirme planı oluşturulabilir.

items.question: Mobil uygulama geliştirmek ne kadar sürer?
items.answer: Süre; kapsam, entegrasyonlar, tasarım karmaşıklığı ve yayın ihtiyaçlarına bağlıdır. Keşif aşaması gerçekçi bir plan oluşturmaya yardımcı olur.

items.question: Güvenlik ve gizlilik nasıl ele alınır?
items.answer: Gereksinimler; kimlik doğrulama, yetkilendirme, hassas veriler, üçüncü taraf hizmetleri ve ilgili kurum politikalarını kapsamalıdır. Bunlar tasarım, uygulama ve test kararlarını yönlendirir.

items.question: Yayından sonra ne olur?
items.answer: Destek sorumlulukları, izleme, sorun yönetimi ve planlanan iyileştirmeler yayından önce belirlenmelidir. Yaklaşım, uygulama ve kullanıcılarıyla birlikte gelişebilir.

items.question: Uygulama mevcut sistemlerimize bağlanabilir mi?
items.answer: Entegrasyon; mevcut API, veri modeli ve erişim ihtiyaçlarının değerlendirilmesiyle başlar. Bu çalışma mobil iş akışlarının sistemlere bağlanması için pratik bir yaklaşım oluşturur.

items.title: توسيع فريقك

items.title: مشروع محدد النطاق

items.title: الاستشارات
items.description: قيّم البنية أو احسم قرارًا تقنيًا أو طوّر خارطة طريق من خلال تعاون استشاري محدد.

items.title: سياق الأعمال أولًا

items.title: تقدم واضح
items.description: العمل من قائمة أولويات مع مراجعات منتظمة للأعمال المنجزة والقرارات القادمة.

items.title: الجودة طوال التنفيذ
items.description: مراعاة سهولة الاستخدام والأمان وقابلية الصيانة إلى جانب تطوير الخصائص.

items.title: تسليم واضح
items.description: توثيق القرارات الأساسية وخطوات الإصدار ومسؤوليات الدعم لتمكين التطبيق من مواصلة التطور.

items.question: كيف نختار بين التطوير الأصلي ومتعدد المنصات؟
items.answer: يعتمد الاختيار على تجربة المستخدم وتكامل الأجهزة وقدرات الفريق وتوقعات الصيانة. تساعد مرحلة الاستكشاف على تقييم هذه الموازنة قبل اختيار النهج.

items.question: هل يمكنكم العمل على تطبيق جوال قائم؟
items.answer: يمكن أن تحدد المراجعة الأولية قيود البنية والجودة والتسليم، ثم توضع خطة لتحسينات محددة أو تحديث التطبيق أو مواصلة تطوير خصائصه.

items.question: كم يستغرق تطوير تطبيق جوال؟
items.answer: تعتمد المدة على النطاق والتكاملات وتعقيد التصميم ومتطلبات الإصدار. تساعد مرحلة الاستكشاف على تحديد مراحل وخطة تنفيذ واقعية.

items.question: كيف تتم معالجة الأمان والخصوصية؟
items.answer: ينبغي أن تشمل المتطلبات المصادقة والتفويض والبيانات الحساسة وخدمات الأطراف الثالثة وسياسات المؤسسة ذات الصلة. وتوجّه هذه المتطلبات قرارات التصميم والتنفيذ والاختبار.

items.question: ماذا يحدث بعد الإطلاق؟
items.answer: ينبغي الاتفاق على مسؤوليات الدعم والمراقبة ومعالجة المشكلات والتحسينات المخطط لها قبل الإصدار. ويمكن أن يتطور النهج مع التطبيق ومستخدميه.

items.question: هل يمكن ربط التطبيق بأنظمتنا الحالية؟
items.answer: يبدأ التكامل بتقييم واجهات API ونماذج البيانات ومتطلبات الوصول المتاحة. ويحدد ذلك نهجًا عمليًا لربط مسارات الجوال بالأنظمة القائمة.

blocks.title: لنتحدث عن تطبيق الجوال الخاص بك
blocks.body: أخبرنا عن المستخدمين أو الفكرة أو التطبيق الحالي. يمكننا استكشاف النطاق وتحديد خطوة عملية تالية.
